summary: Exercise the full autonomous journey with injected failures
description: Build a reproducible campaign fixture from rough request through exploration, decisions, tasks, build, repair, goal review, separate releases and recovery. Reuse existing ABC campaign and regression primitives. Scope and mandate: .go/plans/autonomy-first.json. Reuse released ABC/advice/readiness behavior; implement only this delta.
acceptance: Run real controller/worker processes, Git worktrees and local bare remotes with deterministic adapter doubles; prove more than one serial task progresses and publishes without manually dispatching each task.

Failure matrix covers unresolved material decision with independent eligible work, omitted requirement, failed behavioral critic, repair/no-progress limit, shared budget, controller/orphan failure, dirty Git, changed remote base, lost publication acknowledgement, failed live-readback and cleanup retry.
Preserve raw command output and immutable evidence links; test that false-green mutations are rejected. Tests must exercise behavior, not compare metadata labels or fake provider-model identity.
Gate experimental autonomy claims on this suite and document remaining live-model/runtime limits. No GitHub Actions or real consumer mutations.

Complete this independently shippable stack change with content-bound checks/critic, scoped commit/push, immutable release and remote readback; preserve user dirt and historical evidence. Current request authorizes planning only; no execution or publication starts during intake.

evidence.summary: summary=R1-R5 verified by one-controller two-release behavior proof, injected-failure matrix, exact architecture conformance and immutable v0.3.42 remote readback; verification_command=declared four-command task gate plus compatibility/autonomy gates and Linux release-check 0.3.42 --validate-existing; verification_result=passed: 10 focused tests, 155 compatibility tests, 26 injected-failure tests, 197 smoke tests, make check, validate, diff-check, template pairing and standalone install; critic=passed same-agent hardening review with no blocking findings; runtime=Codex desktop; model=gpt-6-astra high; billing_mode=subscription; self_reflect=product lesson: end-to-end autonomy claims need executable failure bindings and exact release readback. Process miss: direct full-suite execution in a registered worker and an initial Linux clone without its paired template produced invalid environmental failures; recovery used the official isolated collector and immutable sibling template without weakening guards or touching user uv.lock.
